description: Per-industry Context OS templates — CLAUDE.md structure, memory organization, and initial setup prompts

sections.title: Business Identity
sections.description: Who you are, what you do, your specialization
sections.example: We are a mid-market accounting firm specializing in SME audit and tax advisory. Based in [city], serving [region]. Founded [year], [X] employees.
prompts: What does your firm specialize in?
What makes you different from competitors?

sections.title: Client Interaction Rules
sections.example: Always use formal Dutch in client communications. Reference specific regulations by number. Never promise specific outcomes. Include disclaimer on all tax advice.
prompts: What tone do you use with clients?
What language(s) do you communicate in?

sections.title: Decision Framework
sections.description: How decisions are made, approval chains
sections.example: Engagements over EUR 10K require partner approval. New service offerings need full partner meeting. Fee adjustments over 10% need written justification.
prompts: Who signs off on client engagements?

sections.title: Process Standards
sections.example: Every audit follows our 47-step checklist. Client deliverables are reviewed by a second partner. Annual engagement letters updated by January 15.

sections.title: Service Catalog
sections.description: What you offer and standard pricing/packaging
sections.example: Core services: Annual audit (from EUR 5K), Tax advisory (hourly EUR 195), Payroll processing (per employee/month). Premium: CFO-as-a-service, M&A advisory.

memory_structure.clients/: Per-client context: preferences, history, contacts, engagement terms
memory_structure.projects/: Active engagement state: deadlines, open items, decisions made
memory_structure.knowledge/: Industry-specific knowledge: regulations, benchmarks, best practices
memory_structure.team/: Team member profiles: expertise, certifications, availability

sections.title: Practice Identity
sections.example: General dental practice with focus on cosmetic dentistry and implants. 3 dentists, 2 hygienists, 4 support staff. ~2,000 active patients.

sections.title: Patient Communication Rules
sections.description: How you communicate with patients, compliance
sections.example: HIPAA-compliant communications only. Use patient-friendly language (not clinical jargon). Appointment reminders 48h and 24h before. Follow up within 24h of major procedures.
prompts: What are your HIPAA communication protocols?
How do you handle appointment reminders?
What's your follow-up policy after procedures?

sections.title: Clinical Protocols
sections.example: All treatment plans require documented patient consent. X-rays reviewed by two practitioners for major procedures. Insurance pre-authorization for treatments over EUR 1,000.
prompts: What documentation is required for treatment plans?
What are your insurance verification steps?

sections.title: Operational Rules
sections.example: Schedule 15-min buffers between procedures. Same-day emergency slots: 2 per day. Insurance claims submitted within 48h. Monthly inventory audit of supplies.
prompts: How do you structure your schedule?

memory_structure.patients/: Patient preferences, treatment history notes (non-clinical), communication preferences
memory_structure.operations/: Schedule templates, supplier contacts, insurance payer details
memory_structure.compliance/: Regulatory requirements, audit schedules, certification renewals

sections.title: Brand Identity
sections.example: Premium sustainable fashion for millennials. Voice: warm, knowledgeable, never pushy. Price range EUR 50-300. Key values: sustainability, craftsmanship, transparency.

sections.title: Product Rules
sections.example: All product descriptions follow our template: headline (max 60 chars), hero benefit, 3 feature bullets, material/sustainability info, care instructions. Never claim 'best' or 'cheapest'.
prompts: How do you write product descriptions?
How do you handle pricing decisions?

sections.title: Customer Service Standards
sections.example: Respond to all inquiries within 4 hours during business hours. Full refund within 30 days, no questions. Exchanges prioritized over refunds. Escalate to manager if customer mentions legal/social media.
prompts: What are your response time targets?

sections.title: Operations
sections.example: Ship within 24h of order. Low stock alert at 10 units. Never run ads on products with <20 units stock. Black Friday prep starts October 1. Email campaigns: max 2/week to any segment.
prompts: How do you manage inventory alerts?
What marketing rules do you follow?

memory_structure.products/: Product details, seasonal plans, supplier contacts
memory_structure.customers/: VIP customer notes, complaint history, segment definitions
memory_structure.campaigns/: Active marketing campaigns, performance benchmarks, content calendar
memory_structure.operations/: Fulfillment partners, shipping rates, inventory rules

sections.title: Practice Identity
sections.example: Executive leadership coach specializing in tech founders. ICF PCC certified. Methodology: combination of cognitive-behavioral and strengths-based approaches. 1-on-1 and group programs.

sections.title: Client Engagement Rules
sections.example: Sessions are 60 min. Between-session check-ins via Voxer. Strict confidentiality — never reference one client's situation with another. Minimum 3-month commitment. No advice-giving — questions only.

sections.title: Content & Marketing Voice
sections.description: How you show up online, content rules
sections.example: LinkedIn: share insights, never brag about client results without permission. Newsletter: weekly, max 500 words, one actionable takeaway. Never use manipulative urgency tactics.
prompts: What marketing tactics do you avoid?

sections.title: Program Design
sections.description: How programs are structured and priced
sections.example: 1-on-1: EUR 500/session or EUR 5,000/quarter (12 sessions). Group: max 8 participants, EUR 2,000/person/quarter. VIP Day: EUR 3,000 full day intensive.

memory_structure.clients/: Client goals, session notes summaries, progress milestones
memory_structure.content/: Content ideas, published pieces, audience engagement data
